top.name: Artificer's Magnum Opus
top.rules_text: Deploy the Arcanomechanical Colossus on an empty tile within 2 (40 HP, 13 DMG, 2 SPD, range 3). Each activation it fabricates a free Drone; when destroyed it detonates for 6 damage to adjacent enemies.

bottom.name: Full Salvo
bottom.rules_text: Every ready construct you control immediately fires at the nearest enemy within its range (Heat included).
